version: Concept Identity Refinement Pass 2; final internal candidate v5
face_judgment: Materially closer than Pass 1: less exposed eyes, connected brow/root, more projected mature nose and midface, fuller lip plane and defined lower face. Skull and inherited topology still carry some source identity; not an exact portrait reconstruction.
body_judgment: Materially closer than Pass 1: stronger neck/shoulder support, active arm volume, reduced chest dominance, fuller ribcage/waist and less lateral hip emphasis. Natural non-muscular anatomy retained.
limitations: Primary reference is clothed and uncalibrated; inferred anatomy is an artistic interpretation.
Raw blink correctives produce 13 additional triangle-normal warnings versus Pass 1, without RigLogic drivers.
Existing extreme shoulder/elbow/knee skinning volume loss remains.
Pose tests are static samples, not continuous gameplay animation or exhaustive collision testing.
